budget_items.what_was_recorded: The board discussed the history of the grant and two options for using its money: repair or maintenance of a current system, or re-loaning the funds to Lunenburg town residents, with internal or outside management.
budget_items.quote: in addition, management of the grant can be internal or through an outside agency.

budget_items.topic: Septic loan program and betterment fees
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Criteria for a resident loan program were discussed, including that betterment fees could not be included if sewer connection was part of the loan program.
budget_items.quote: if sewer connection where included in the loan program, betterment fees could not be included.
